scope: Preparation. No production receiver, membership issuance, v2 transport route, native storage or browser campaign is implemented by these tests.

testedModelRepair.finding: The candidate verified parsed input but retained caller-owned request/page buffers after asynchronous crypto. Mutation during verification replaced the saved bytes.
testedModelRepair.repair: Bound and capture all input byte strings before awaiting crypto. Recheck lifetime before duplicate results and before staging.
testedModelRepair.evidence: buffer-counterexample.log and buffer-repair.log; final exact-byte/close test
testedModelRepair.classification: Test-only candidate composition defect, not a reported defect in the shipped sender or existing envelope primitive.

designDispositions: Use independently authenticated semantic genesis and zero publisher links; state vectors omit deletion coverage.
Separate reader authorization from publisher identity; proposed v2 framing remains fixture-only.
Persist content, inbound evidence, derived receive progress and witness in one transaction before editor promotion.
Pending structs/deletions can be durably received; retain original frames through restart and incomplete compaction.
Retain exact original envelopes/proofs; never convert remote input to a reader-owned source capsule.
First receiver uses one page entry, at most 512 KiB envelope wire, 255 updates and 512 KiB decoded updates, checked against 4 MiB/256 local records.
A stale duplicate contributes no new durable high-water knowledge; re-fetch from the current cursor.
controls: Unheld predecessor makes a signed head self-authorizing.
A state vector alone misses deletion coverage.
Cursor-first split loses content after a crash.
Dropping pending deletion from snapshot changes eventual text.
Early remote promotion admits an offline-unrecoverable dependent local edit.
A global cursor skips another publisher.
Raw capture relabels received bytes under the reader.

generated.commands: 4..24 delivery actions over two synthetic publisher streams, each with selected before/after/no commit cut, close and compaction; restart and external checks after every action, then complete drain.
generated.oracle: External committed source/receipt ledger derives expected publisher positions, exact wires/proofs and original Yjs replay. It does not derive its expected content from model storage.
generated.result: No additional counterexample in the final generated campaign.

launch.outcome: The pnpm wrapper emitted no output and had not launched a child runner when inspected; only that task process was stopped. Cause not diagnosed.
launch.note: The registered package alias points at that exact Node script. No successful execution of the pnpm wrapper or full pnpm check is claimed.

limits: Synthetic independently held membership/baseline, not two-gate enrollment evidence.
The model uses atomic JS assignment and a synthetic hash witness, not AEAD/IndexedDB commit or native exclusion.
Model restart uses previously verified event objects. Runtime cold replay must reverify original authenticated wire and current authority.
The proposed v2 fixture consumer is not a complete malformed-frame codec conformance suite.
No browser is used; existing async Playwright waits are not credited or broadly audited.
Whole-state rollback/clone resistance, pruning, epochs/generations and deployment remain open.
